researchNotes: Official site nabeelperfumes.com returned 503 (not opened), so every note list is 'reported' from the retailer Arabic Parfums (2-page Nabeel collection, ~45 items; incense sticks, roll-on oils and non-listed products skipped; later items such as Crown of Emirates, Bankam, Al Bashiq Shama, Asateer, Maghateer series, Roeya, Ocean variants not opened). Concentration recorded only where page text says Eau de Parfum (image filenames ignored). Irth pyramid is an unusually long retailer list that looks aggregated; treat with caution. Irth Boom exists per a Parfumo search result only (Parfumo returns 403), so no data. Brand origin: Nabeel founded 1969 in Aden, relocated to UAE and relaunched 1990, per a Khaleej Times/search snippet; country UAE is based on that. BJ Distribuzione page returned empty. Marketing text not copied. Editorial review: Anar notes removed because its source page appears to mix in another product (BLU ZAFFIRO). Notes pass 2026-11-16: official site still 503 on WebFetch; no new data. Performance filled from search snippets (basis search/retailer) where stated. Roll-on pass 2026-11-20: added 38 6 ml roll-on concentrated oils as separate '<name> Roll-On' entries; notes 'reported' from BJ Distribuzione's nabeel.eu roll-on category (3 pages, 36 items; the generic 'Nabeel Roll On' assortment and any items on a possible page 4 not added) plus the nabeelperfumes.online store (Bahi/Bois family, Sandalia, Tawasul, Ward); nabeelperfumes.com still not loadable. Roll-on notes were taken from each roll-on page, not reused from sprays; Acqua di Nabeel Absolute and Irth roll-on lists are long aggregated lists, treat with caution. Maghateer Kilsa page type line says Spray Perfume although listed as roll-on. Nasaem heart note 'Muggo' omitted as unclear.
